DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込のご相談ですね。振込先が書かれたものをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a transfer. Do you have something showing the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この家賃の請求書です。支店名の下の「普通」は、口座の種類でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃請求書を示して普通が口座種類か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This rent invoice. Does “ordinary” below the branch name mean the account type?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the rent invoice and ask whether “ordinary” is the account type. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、普通預金を表します。支店名と口座番号はこちらの欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, it means an ordinary deposit account. These fields are the branch name and account number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここを転記するのですね。受取人が会社名ですが、大家さんの名前と違ってもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転記箇所を確認し受取人会社名と大家の名前の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I copy these, correct? The recipient is a company; is it all right that it differs from the landlord's name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check what to copy and ask about the company recipient differing from the landlord. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理会社の口座のようですが、振り込む前に請求書の発行元へ確認してください。すでに確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It appears to be a management-company account, but confirm with the invoice issuer before transferring. Have you checked already?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、管理会社に電話して、この口座でよいと言われました。依頼人欄には何を書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 管理会社への確認結果を伝え依頼人欄の記入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I called the management company and they said this account was right. What goes in the remitter field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the management company's confirmation and ask what to write as remitter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通常はお客様のお名前です。この請求書には、名前の前に部屋番号を付ける指定もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Usually your name. This invoice also specifies putting the room number before your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三〇五を名前の前に付けます。手数料を含めて、いくらになるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前の前に部屋番号を付けると答え手数料込みの額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put 305 before my name. I would like to know the amount including the fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will put your room number before your name and ask the fee-inclusive amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 振込額は六万円で、こちらの案内では今回の手数料が四百四十円です。合計は六万四百四十円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The transfer is sixty thousand yen. This guidance gives a fee of four hundred forty yen this time, totaling sixty thousand four hundred forty yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合計は六万四百四十円ですね。依頼人欄は、三〇五と私の名前でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手数料込みの合計額を確認して依頼人表記を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sixty thousand four hundred forty total, correct? Please use 305 and my name as the remitter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the fee-inclusive total and specify the remitter notation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入用紙をお渡ししますので、こちらでお書きください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the form; please fill it out here. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は以上でよろしいですか。レジ袋は必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that everything for checkout? Do you need a shopping bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このかごの商品で全部です。食品用の袋は持っていますが、洗剤用に小さい袋を一枚ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 全商品で会計すると伝え食品用袋を持参し洗剤用袋を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Everything in this basket. I have a food bag, but please give me one small bag for the detergent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say all items are for checkout, you brought a food bag and need a detergent bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さい袋を一枚お付けします。洗剤はこちらに分けて置きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will add one small bag and separate the detergent here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。卵は重いものと分けて、自分で最後に入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗剤の分離を頼み卵は自分で最後に入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I want to separate eggs from heavy items and pack them myself last.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request separating detergent and say you will pack eggs yourself last. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 卵はかごの手前に置いておきます。お支払いは現金ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will put the eggs at the front of the basket. Are you paying cash?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カードで払いたいです。このカードは使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カード払いを希望してカードの利用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to pay by card. Can I use this one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request card payment and ask whether the card can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、ご利用いただけます。袋代を含めて二千百六十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Including the bag, it is two thousand one hundred sixty yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二千百六十円ですね。カードは、この端末に差し込めばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合計額を確認しカードを差し込む位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two thousand one hundred sixty. Should I insert my card into this terminal?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the total and ask where to insert the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、下の差込口です。画面の案内に沿って操作してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the slot at the bottom. Follow the screen instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 支払いできました。カードを抜いたので、レシートもお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払い完了とカード回収を伝えレシートを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Payment worked. I removed my card, so please give me the receipt too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report payment and retrieving the card, then request a receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらがレシートです。ありがとうございました、またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the receipt. Thank you; please visit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この先は工事で通れません。散歩でしたら、手前の道から回れますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You cannot pass ahead because of construction. For a walk, you can detour via the path before it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口から来たところです。遠くまで回らず、あと十分くらいで休める道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入口から来たと伝え短時間で休める代替経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I just came from the entrance. Is there a path where I can rest in about ten more minutes without a long detour?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came from the entrance and ask a short alternative route to a resting place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 左の舗装路なら、五分ほどで屋根のある休憩所に着きます。砂の道より足元が安定しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The paved path on the left reaches a covered rest area in about five minutes. The footing is steadier than the sandy path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 舗装路を選びます。左に分かれる道が二本ありますが、どちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 舗装路を選び二本の分岐のどちらか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will take the paved path. Two paths branch left; which one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the paved path and ask which of two branches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手前の広いほうです。「休憩所」と書かれた白い矢印が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The nearer, wider one, marked by a white arrow saying “Rest area.”

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白い矢印ですね。休憩所から入口へ戻るには、この道を引き返しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 矢印を確認して休憩所から入口への戻り道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The white arrow, correct? To return from the rest area to the entrance, do I retrace this path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the arrow and ask the route back to the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 引き返せますが、休憩所の裏のまっすぐな道を使うと入口まで三分ほどです。そちらは工事をしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can, but the straight path behind the rest area reaches the entrance in about three minutes. There is no construction there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏からの道に階段はありませんか。段差が少ないほうが助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏の道の階段と段差を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Are there stairs on that back path? Fewer level changes would help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check stairs and level changes on the back path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 階段はありません。出口に低い段差が一か所あるので、そこだけ気をつけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: No stairs. There is one low step at the exit, so watch that point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、白い矢印の道で休憩所へ行き、帰りは裏から入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩所への経路と裏から戻る予定を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will follow the white arrow to the rest area and return to the entrance from the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Restate the route to the rest area and return from the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、いってらっしゃいませ。どうぞ散歩をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行情報についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about service information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。十時二十分の列車で、中央駅の待ち合わせに行く予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 利用予定の時刻と目的地を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I plan to take the ten-twenty train to meet someone at Central Station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your planned departure time and destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その列車は、今のところ十五分ほど遅れる見込みです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That train is currently expected about fifteen minutes late.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中央駅には十一時に着きたいのですが、間に合いそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着希望時刻を示して見込みを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to reach Central Station at eleven. Does it look possible?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the desired arrival time and ask the outlook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通常はここから四十分ですから、このままだと少し過ぎる見込みです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It normally takes forty minutes from here, so on the present estimate you will arrive a little after.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の急行に乗ったほうが早いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 急行という別案を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Would taking the next express be quicker?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the express alternative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 急行は動いていますが、中央駅には停まりません。一つ手前で各駅停車への乗り換えが必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The express is running, but does not stop at Central. You must transfer to a local at the station before it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗り換えを含めると、中央駅には何時ごろ着きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗り換え後の到着時刻を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Including the transfer, about what time would I reach Central?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask arrival time including the transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経路では十一時十分ごろです。今お待ちの列車と大きくは変わりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: About eleven-ten by that route. Not much different from the train you are waiting for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、この列車を待ちます。相手には十一時半に変えてもらうよう連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用列車と待ち合わせ変更を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will wait for this train. I will contact the other person to move the meeting to eleven-thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the train and change of meeting time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発車案内にお気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Watch for departure information, and have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 生活相談の予約をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a daily-life consultation appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。引っ越したあとに届いた通知を、読んでいただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知を読む相談を予約したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want someone to read a notice that arrived after my move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request an appointment for help reading the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知の差出人がわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know who sent it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 市役所の保険の担当です。日本語が難しいので、ベトナム語の通訳をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 差出人と希望言語を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The insurance department at city hall. The Japanese is difficult, so I would like a Vietnamese interpreter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the sender and requested language. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通訳を手配する相談枠をご案内します。平日の午前と午後では、どちらが来やすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will show you a slot with an interpreter arranged. On weekdays, is morning or afternoon easier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 仕事が午後からなので、午前中がいいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務時間に合わせて午前を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My work starts in the afternoon, so morning is better.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request morning to suit your work schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 来週の火曜日、九時半の枠が空いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Next Tuesday at nine-thirty is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その時間でお願いします。通知のほかに、何を持っていけばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約日時を選んで持ち物を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: That time, please. Besides the notice, what should I bring?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the appointment and ask what to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封筒も一緒にお持ちください。相談で聞きたいことがあれば、メモにしていただくと助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Bring the envelope too. A note of your questions would also help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知と封筒、それから質問のメモを持って、火曜日の九時半に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時と持ち物を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring the notice, envelope and question notes on Tuesday at nine-thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Restate the time and items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご予約をお受けしました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your appointment is accepted. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察前の検査のご案内ですね。指示書を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You need directions to tests before the consultation. Let me see the order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。採血を先に受けるように言われましたが、場所がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指示書を示して検査場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here it is. I was told to have blood drawn first, but do not know the place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the order and ask the test location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 採血室は同じ階の奥です。青い線に沿って進むと受付があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The blood-draw room is at the back of this floor. Follow the blue line to reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付では、この紙を出せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 採血受付で渡すものを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Should I hand this paper in there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check what to hand over at blood-draw reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、指示書をお出しください。お名前を呼ばれるまで、そちらの席でお待ちいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, the order. Wait in the seats there until your name is called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 採血のあと、そのまま診察室へ行ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 採血後に向かう場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: After blood is drawn, can I go straight to the consultation room?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to go after the blood draw. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いったんこちらの外来受付に戻ってください。次のご案内をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Return here to outpatient reception first, and we will guide you next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。採血で気分が悪くなったことがあるので、横になって受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 以前の体調変化と横になる希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I have felt ill during a blood draw before, so I would like to lie down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your past reaction and request lying down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのことを採血担当の看護師にお伝えください。こちらからも申し送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell the blood-draw nurse. We will also pass it on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。青い線をたどって行き、担当の方にも話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 経路と担当者に伝える事項をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will follow the blue line and tell the person in charge too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the route and information for staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お気をつけて。終わりましたらこちらへお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, take care. Return here when finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵の件でご連絡した方ですね。届出の番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are the person we contacted about the keys. Please give the report number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この控えの番号です。昨日、駅の近くで鍵をなくしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 届出番号と紛失状況を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, the number on this copy. I lost my keys near the station yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the report number and loss circumstances. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受け取りの前に、鍵に付けていた物を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before collection, could you describe what was attached to the keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 緑の布のストラップです。端に白い糸で名前を縫ってあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 付属品の色と名入れを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: A green fabric strap, with my name sewn in white thread at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the accessory color and embroidered name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鍵は何本付いていましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三本です。自転車の小さい鍵も一緒に付けていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵の本数と種類を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three, including a small bicycle key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the number and types of keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの物ですね。身分証を拝見して、お名前を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: These, correct? I will check your name against identification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。引っ越したので、届出の住所と違っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 身分証を示して住所の変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. I moved, so the address differs from the report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show identification and say the address changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい住所を確認できる書類もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you also have a document confirming the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、この書類です。鍵も自分の物で間違いありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新住所の書類を出して自分の鍵と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, this document. The keys are definitely mine too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present the new-address document and confirm your keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できましたのでお返しします。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Confirmed, so I will return them. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のお受け取りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私宛ての荷物を受け取りに、不在票を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票と本人宛てであることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought a missed-delivery notice to collect a parcel addressed to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention the notice and that the parcel is addressed to you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不在票と本人確認書類を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the notice and identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。荷物の宛先には、部屋番号が抜けているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類を示して宛先の不足を指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. The parcel's address seems to be missing my room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show documents and point out the missing address detail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お名前と住所を照合します。お住まいの部屋番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will compare the name and address. Please give your room number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二〇一です。同じ建物に、似た名前の人も住んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号と照合に役立つ事情を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: 201. Someone with a similar name lives in the same building too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the room number and circumstances useful for checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できました。こちらのお荷物ですので、受け取り欄にご署名ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Confirmed. Here is your parcel, so sign the receipt section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 署名しました。思ったより大きいですが、手提げ袋を持ってきていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受領署名して持ち運びの困り事を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have signed. It is bigger than I expected, but I did not bring a carrying bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sign and explain the carrying problem. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱の取っ手を使えます。重さを確かめてから、お持ちになってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can use the box handle. Check the weight before carrying it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 取っ手なら持てそうです。このまま持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱の取っ手で持ち帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I think I can manage with the handle. I will carry it home as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to carry it home by the box handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。足元にお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Watch your step on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードをなくされたとのことですね。口座のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You lost your card, correct? Please give the account name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 山本です。駅のＡＴＭを使ったあと、キャッシュカードが見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名義と最後にカードを使った場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yamamoto. After using the station ATM, I cannot find my cash card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the account name and last place the card was used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人を確認できる書類はお持ちですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 運転免許証を持っています。口座番号は、スマートフォンのアプリで見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人照合書類と口座番号の確認方法を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My driver's license. I can see the account number in my smartphone app.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show identity documents and how to check the account number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拝見しますね。照合できましたので、このカードの利用停止を進めてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see. Your identity matches; may we block this card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、止めてください。もし家で見つかっても、そのまま使えないんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 利用停止を頼み発見後の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, block it. If I find it at home, can I not just use it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request blocking and ask what to do if found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 停止したカードは、そのまま使わずにこちらへご連絡ください。停止の手続きが済みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not use a blocked card as it is; contact us. Blocking is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。新しいカードを作ると、受け取りは郵送ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再発行カードの受取方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. If I request a new card, is receipt by mail?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how a reissued card is received. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この窓口の手続きでは、ご登録の住所へ郵送します。登録住所に変更はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: With this counter's procedure, we mail it to your registered address. Has the address changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所は変わっていません。そちらへ送る再発行の申込書をください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所を確認して再発行申込書を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. Please give me the reissue application for sending it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the address and request a reissue form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here it is. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a product question?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昨日買った保存容器のふたに、ひびが入っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入時期と不具合を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The lid of the storage container I bought yesterday was cracked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the purchase date and defect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品とレシートを拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the product and receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。箱から出したときに気づいたので、まだ使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商品とレシートを出して未使用と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. I noticed when taking it from the box, so have not used it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the product and receipt and say it is unused. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ふたの端にひびがありますね。同じ商品の新品と交換できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The lid edge is cracked. We can replace it with a new one of the same product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。新しいものは、ふたを開けて見てから受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 交換品の状態をその場で見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. May I open the new lid and look before accepting it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request checking the replacement on the spot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、ここで一緒に状態をご覧いただけます。こちらが交換品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we can check together here. Here is the replacement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ひびはありませんが、ふたが少し固いです。閉め方を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ふたの閉め方を実演してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is no crack, but the lid is a little stiff. Could you show how to close it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a demonstration of closing the lid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この角から順に押すと閉まります。最後に四つの角がはまっているかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Press each corner in order from this one. Finally check all four are engaged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: できました。これを受け取りますので、元の箱に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交換品を受け取り梱包を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I did it. I will take this one; please put it in the original box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept the replacement and request packing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。お手数をおかけしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We are sorry for the trouble.
